chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Aslam, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:

I said to Abu al-Hasan Musa عليه السلام: I came to Kufah and had not fasted the seven days, until I departed on a need to Baghdad. He said: Fast them in Baghdad. I said: May I separate them? He said: Yes.

key_terms.أُفَرِّقُهَا: shall I separate them, meaning perform the fasts non-consecutively
key_terms.السَّبْعَةَ الْأَيَّامِ: the seven days of fasting under discussion in this ruling
key_terms.الْكُوفَةَ: Kufah, the city mentioned as the place first reached by the questioner
key_terms.بَغْدَادَ: Baghdad, where the Imam عليه السلام permitted the fasting to be observed

ai.seo_question: Can the seven days of fasting be done separately after traveling to another city?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the seven days of fasting, indicating that they may be performed in Baghdad after leaving Kufah. It also states that these days do not have to be consecutive, since the Imam عليه السلام permitted separating them.
